reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:bec1969ed77f6ad44c7121e1e2811e5e]] It was with great glee that I saw the Amazon truck pull up! Could it be my much anticipated dental floss? Yes it was. I have tightly spaced teeth and it has been a life-long quest to find a dental floss that won't break or shred. After much trial and error I finally tried the Oral-B Glide PRO_HEALTH Comfort Plus Floss (mint flavored). Each dispenser contains 18.1 yards so the six pack contains 108.6 yards (99,303.84 mm). Save yourself the time and fru

This is my normal brand and flavor of floss that I usually buy at the grocery store in single or double packs. However, I ran out between shopping trips so I ordered this giant pack. It tastes the same. It looks similar. It feels slightly thinner. The one thing that has been driving me nuts is that these cases are super flimsy! I'm not sure if its from shipping or what. I opened the first one and pulled the string out and the whole case came apart. I opened a second and the same thing happened.

My teeth are very closely spaced so I have difficulty with getting some floss between them. The OralB mint floss is perfect as it's shaped more like a ribbon than the usual floss. It gently glides between my teeth with little effort. This is the only kind of floss I use.
I don't know what it is with these large packages of floss but expect 3/6 to be unattached to the metal prong and you will have to wind them yourself. Not a big deal but inconvenient.

reviews.t: Price keeps going up, but this is the best.
reviews.x: My hygienist recommended this over the little flossing tool I had before. Sometimes old school is best. It's flat tape, so it's easy to slide between teeth. I floss religiously every night and it's saved my wallet so far at dentist check ups.
I have tried other dental floss - some are too thin, others get stuck in my teeth & I end up breaking the floss just to get it out of my mouth.  Very happy with this brand, so I am sticking with it!

reviews.t: Try this trick to easily use this great floss.
reviews.x: Have trouble holding this great floss? Try this: cut a piece about 14 inches long. Double it over then tie a simple overhand knot four to five inches down to form a loop slightly wider than your hand. Gently try to floss a tooth. Adjust the knot to an ideal size for you. The magic is that the knot is easily moved by separately pulling the ends. Once it's optimal tie a second knot and tease it until it sits on the first knot. They will now be locked into position. I like these over any other brands. The ones that are shaped like strings are uncomfortable. These however are shaped like tapes and fit right between the teeth.
Flavor on package indicates mint, but it’s vanilla flavored.
Mismanufactured containers fall apart. Do not buy!

Product lost a star for being overpriced (not just on amazon, but everywhere). Overpriced because one out of every 3 sessions, the floss (made of thin plastic) breaks. I'm sure this is by design, meaning that Oral-B knows you'll have to get a whole new strand whenever you want to finish flossing after breakage, thereby speeding usage of the roll by around 30%. I was worried that perhaps these were counterfeit, but they're genuine Glide floss.  This is the only floss that easily slides between my teeth and doesn't "cut" into my gums.  Makes flossing easy and not a chore!
When you open the pack it does smell minty, BUT NO mint flavor or smell on the floss.....totally not worth the any extra expense for this floss.

reviews.t: This floss doesn't break off or get stuck between your teeth.
reviews.x: Liked the fact that it glides easily between teeth.  This is especially helpful if you have crowns or implants.

reviews.t: It's dental floss. In a 6 pack
reviews.x: Okay, so what can I say? It's dental floss. Not exactly as exciting. But the 6 pack insures I won't run out.
Always use this brand because my teeth are close and and difficult to floss
In description it say 2 packs of 6 for $23 i received only one pack

reviews.t: Easily the best floss I've ever purchased. Well worth the price!
reviews.x: This version of Glide is easily the best floss I've ever purchased. I have a little bit of crowding so I have a slight fear of having floss get stuck at times but this floss is sturdy and works like a charm. It is easy to move through and get the job done quite quickly and efficiently. I've bought other brands of floss that were less effective: would break, split or just was tough to get through teeth. Anyhow, this Oral B pack of 6 works fantastic, and will last for quite a long time. Not to men

I purchased this brand because what I used to use was constantly shredding. Good news: Oral B floss doesn't shred. Bad news: When I pull just a teeny bit much, it breaks in half -- otherwise I would be in love with it. I have really tight teeth, and it gets between them. But having to waste so much of it because of breakage makes its value go way down in my book.

There are lots of dental floss options out there but for our needs, Oral-B Pro-Health Comfort Plus Mint Floss  is the best.  I have a lot of dental work and the floss slips between tight teeth easily and does a great job of cleaning.  We try to order in bulk (6-12 rolls at a time) to be more cost effective.  I wouldn't use anything else!

I love the convenient container the floss is enclosed in and the floss is the right thickness for me and the little cutter clip is perfect.  And did  I mention that the flavor is very refreshing and along with the generous length of floss, and the strong non shredding material makes this my favorite.

The casing fell apart the first time I touched the box. I had to duct tape around it to make it usable and still the floss slides through intro crevasses and tears off and breaks. It's a hassle to use, and adds an extra minute or two to just get the floss out. Do not buy this.

reviews.t: The quality has gone downhill lately
reviews.x: Lately I have noticed it shreds robbing me of a portion of the product and it easily and comes off track to where I have to cut it with the scissors. If I don't see an improvement soon I will switch brands.
Great floss.  Feels good sliding in between your teeth, and it has never broken on me before. Slightly flavored, but not like it's going to leave a taste in your mouth or have you licking your lips.
Missing one container of lloss!  Package was opened and one container of floss was missing!  Item is expensive so we would appreciate reimbursement.  Thank you! Lorraine and Paul McAllister

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the floss for gliding easily between tightly spaced teeth and not breaking or shredding.
Several reviewers note the floss is flat/tape-shaped, which they find easier to slide between teeth than string-style floss.
Some reviewers report the floss breaks or shreds during use, and a few mention unwound or falling-apart containers.
A few reviewers complain about the flavor, saying the mint-labeled product lacks mint flavor or tastes like vanilla.
Some reviewers feel the product is overpriced, with one noting the price keeps going up.
